pages.text: Machines are not built. They are $(l)grown$().$(br2)Rotten flesh and bone meal in a bottle make a $(item)Culture Jar$(). Pour $(l)4 drams$() of one aspect into it and it quickens into a $(l)Culture$() of that aspect.

pages.title: The Frame
pages.text: Build a frame of $(item)Copper Armature$() in whatever shape you like, and set the culture into one of its blocks. That block becomes the organism's $(l)core$().$(br2)The frame is the organism's future body. Its shape is a decision.
